import importlib
import semver
importlib.reload(semver)

# Additional edge case tests
print("=== Additional checks ===")

# R1: Also check that built-in attribute access errors still work
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
try:
    v.nonexistent
    print("  nonexistent attr: unexpected success")
except AttributeError:
    print("  nonexistent attr: OK (AttributeError)")

# R2: Iteration with None prerelease/build
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
values = list(v)
print(f"  iter(None prerelease/build): {values}")

# R4: Bump methods preserve prerelease/build
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build1')
print(f"  bump_major preserves prerelease: {v.bump_major().prerelease}")
print(f"  bump_minor preserves build: {v.bump_minor().build}")
print(f"  bump_patch full: {v.bump_patch()}")
print(f"  bump_prerelease full: {v.bump_prerelease()}")
print(f"  bump_build full: {v.bump_build()}")

# R7: replace with no args returns copy
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build1')
v2 = v.replace()
print(f"  replace() with no args: {v2}")
print(f"  same values: {v2.major == v.major and v2.minor == v.minor and v2.patch == v.patch}")

# Check __hash__ for immutability (should be hashable if immutable)
try:
    h = hash(v)
    print(f"  hash works: {h}")
except TypeError as e:
    print(f"  hash fails: {e}")
